verdict_reason: The zigzag construction is exact against ground truth, and it now runs the REAL engine: dionysus is installed here, so _true_zigzag_barcode executes fast_zigzag rather than a proxy. On a 24-point layer sequence with a circle placed only in layers 2-4 (pattern LLCCCLL) dionysus returns exactly one H1 bar [2.0, 5.0) -- the correct lifetime -- and BLME's band summary independently gives h1_num_bands 1.0 and h1_max_band_length 3.0. Pattern LLCCLLC gives exactly two bars, [2.0, 4.0) and [6.0, 7.0), matching the two circle runs; LLLLLLL gives zero bars; CCCCCCC gives one bar [0.0, 7.0) with zz_true_full_depth = 1.0 and zz_true_adjacent_min = 1.0, which is the paper's defining Z_p(l, l) = 1 identity holding exactly. The intersection-based A3-quiver formula for _h1_persisting_edges is derived correctly (m[1,3] = dim Z1(M) - dim((Z1(M) n B1(A)) + (Z1(M) n B1(B)))) and uses a genuine GF(2) Zassenhaus subspace intersection, not a rank shortcut. tests/tasks/parity/test_zigzag_parity.py: 25 passed, none skipped.
comparable_reason: At the shipped protocol 12 of the 16 feature-eligible columns are EXACTLY CONSTANT across five models (gpt2, distilgpt2, pythia-70m, pythia-160m, opt-125m): betti1_fraction_layers, h1_first_layer, h1_last_layer, h1_loop_layer_sum, h1_max_band_length, h1_num_bands and h1_total_layer_persistence are all exactly 0.0; h0_first_layer_components, h0_last_layer_components and h0_mean_components are all exactly 1.0; h0_persistence_range, zz_true_adjacent_min and zz_true_full_depth are all exactly 0.0. sd = 0 on every one. Only four columns vary at all: zz_h1_turnover_rate (sd 0.131), zz_true_adjacent_mean (0.144), zz_true_mean_bar_len (0.356) and zz_true_n_bars (6.50). A column with zero variance cannot be compared across models because it does not distinguish them.
normalized_ok_detail: It is a Jaccard distance on the two layers' H1 classes, (born + died)/(dim_a + born), bounded in [0,1] and symmetric, and it does vary across models (0.5267 to 0.8667 over five). The raw counts it replaces are correctly demoted -- I confirmed the scale dependence they were demoted for: zz_true_n_bars goes 13 -> 108 -> 340 -> 963 as num_samples goes 40 -> 100 -> 200 -> 400 on gpt2.
github_reason: dionysus (the paper's own engine) is installed and _true_zigzag_barcode calls dio.zigzag_homology_persistence directly, so the zz_true_* family IS the reference computation, not a proxy. I drove it on four synthetic layer sequences with known lifetimes and it returned the by-construction-correct barcodes in every case. I did not fetch ZigZagLLMs' own shipped llama_3_8b CSV; the source records a prior head-to-head against it that fixed the Z_p denominator (0.0705 vs the required 1.0, 14.3x).
paper_reason: Gardinazzi et al.'s defining identity Z_p(l, l) = 1 (every bar alive at l trivially spans [l, l]) reproduces exactly: on an all-circle layer sequence zz_true_adjacent_min = zz_true_full_depth = 1.0. Footnote 6's Z_p = 0 convention when beta_p(l1) = 0 is implemented as the released post_process.py does. The paper's headline layer-band figures are for Llama-3-8B, which is outside this host's model budget.
confounds_reason: Twelve columns are constants, so they carry no signal of any kind, architectural or otherwise. Of the four that vary, zz_true_n_bars is a raw cycle count that scales steeply with the point count (13 -> 963 as N goes 40 -> 400) and with graph degree (3 at k=10 vs 40 at k=3, same N=40), and zz_true_mean_bar_len is measured in LAYER units with no depth normalisation, so it inherits n_layers (12-layer models 2.15/1.41/1.90 vs 6-layer 1.78/1.15). The task is absent from all 66 archived envelopes so I could not correlate over the zoo.
defects: THE ENTIRE H1 BAND FAMILY IS IDENTICALLY ZERO AT THE SHIPPED CONFIG, and it is the persistence_frac threshold, not small N. Sweeping gpt2: at persistence_frac = 0.3 (shipped) betti1_fraction_layers and h1_num_bands are exactly 0.0000 / 0.00 at num_samples = 40, 100, 200 AND 400. At the same N = 40 with persistence_frac = 0.10 they are 0.6667 / 3.00 and at 0.05 they are 0.9167 / 2.00. So `persistence_frac: 0.3` -- a threshold of 30% of the geodesic diameter -- is unreachable for real hidden states, and seven shipped feature columns are dead because of it.

h0 is degenerate too: at num_samples = 40 with k = 5 the symmetric kNN graph is always connected, so h0_mean_components = h0_first = h0_last = 1.0 and h0_persistence_range = 0.0 on all five models. Only at N = 100+ does h0_mean move off 1.0 (1.250 at N=100/200, 1.417 at N=400).

The two H1 detectors inside the task DISAGREE on real data and nothing reconciles them. _layer_topology (ripser on geodesics, thresholded at persistence_frac) reports 0 loops in every layer of gpt2, while _true_zigzag_barcode (flag complex of the same kNN graph, no threshold) reports 13 H1 bars on the same clouds. The band family and the zz_true_* family are therefore telling opposite stories about the same model.

SCHEMA INSTABILITY: when the barcode has no bars, _zigzag_paper_metric returns only {'zz_true_n_bars': 0} -- zz_true_adjacent_mean, zz_true_adjacent_min, zz_true_full_depth and zz_true_mean_bar_len are ABSENT from the result dict rather than NaN. A model with no H1 bars silently drops four columns instead of reporting them as undefined.

zz_true_mean_bar_len is in absolute layer units, so a bar spanning 2 of 6 layers and one spanning 2 of 64 score the same; there is no depth-normalised twin (the sibling h1_first_layer/h1_last_layer ARE normalised by n_layers - 1).

The dionysus path is wrapped in a bare `except Exception` that silently falls back to the GF(2) pairwise family, and nothing in the output records which engine produced the numbers -- so a host without dionysus emits a DIFFERENT metric set under the same task name with no flag.
fix: Lower persistence_frac to ~0.05-0.10 (measured: 0.10 gives betti1_fraction_layers 0.6667 on gpt2 at N=40) or drop the threshold and report the persistence distribution, and raise num_samples above 40 so h0 is not pinned at 1; emit NaN rather than omitting the four zz_true_* keys when there are no bars; add zz_true_mean_bar_len_frac = mean_bar_len/(n_layers-1); emit _meta_zz_engine so the dionysus and fallback paths are distinguishable.
